alina: Heads-up: rolling out Dedicated "micro-burst" pools in FRA (eu-central) with H200p and A10G+ hardware. Goal: fast, low-latency short allocations for demos and interactive workloads. Launch window: Tue Jun 8 2026 02:00 UTC. Details below.

ops-bot: Roll created: dedicated/fra-microburst-v1. Canary order: fra-zone1 -> fra-zone2. Alerts: #dedicated-ops #support #billing.

ajosh: Quick Q: are these replacing existing FRA burst pools?

alina: No. New micro-burst pools are additive. Legacy burst pools remain available until capacity pressure requires rebalancing (we'll notify). Micro-burst is distinct: per-allocation max 8h, default per-account quota 6h/day, preemptible with soft-drain semantics.

carla: Pricing? Will this affect committed customers?

alina: Micro-burst charged at 1.2x per-GPU-hour. Reserved/committed contracts unaffected. We added an opt-out toggle for orgs under contract. Billing preview tile added in Console.

simeon: Scheduler behavior and preemption signals? Need runbook for oncall.

alina: Scheduler uses low-latency lane; preemption order: public shared < micro-burst < reserved. Preemption sends a 60s drain signal by default, configurable up to 180s for eligible allocs. Runbook uploaded: <internal://playbooks/fra-microburst-runbook>. Metrics: microburst.alloc.latency_p95, microburst.preempt.count.

billing-bot: Auto-email list prepared. Required notice: 10 days for customers with >8 burst hours last 30d. Template: <internal://billing/templates/microburst-notice>.

ajosh: Can customers request higher micro-burst quota?

alina: Yes — via Console or `redwoodctl quota request --type microburst --hours 24 --reason "demo"`. Sales can approve org-level uplifts.

carla: Please add an FAQ for sales and canned support replies. Also timeline for console banners?

alina: FAQ and canned replies uploaded to sales kit. Console banners scheduled to go live at rollout start. I'll post a final ping in #sales when banners flip.

ops-bot: Canary: fra-zone1 completed with stable metrics. Canary: fra-zone2 scheduled 2026-06-08T03:30Z. Full rollout target 24-36h pending telemetry.
